output.explanation: refundCapture sent the refund POST without a PayPal-Request-Id header, so if the response was lost and the refund route was retried, PayPal would treat it as a new refund request. It now sends a PayPal-Request-Id that defaults to `refund-${captureId}`, so a retry of the same full refund reuses the id and PayPal returns the original result instead of processing it again. An optional requestId parameter lets future partial-refund callers pass an id taken from their own refund record. The only current caller, the refund route, refunds the full order total, so it needs no change.
